scope: unrun workers for one controlled EUD boot-only activation; no host flash implementation

fresh_private_guard_fields.transaction_id: new eud-boot- plus 8..64 lowercase alphanumeric/hyphen characters; all host/remote action paths absent
fresh_private_guard_fields.token: new 32..64 lowercase hex characters; same token in all quiesce/restart/host action receipts
fresh_private_guard_fields.boot_id: fresh exact current UUID and exact old_boot_guard_path contents
fresh_private_guard_fields.soc_serial_sha256: fresh exact raw bytes from /sys/devices/soc0/serial_number; private, no fallback

prepare_prerequisites: root has actual exclusive handoff, not merely a lease; camera481 return proof is provenance, not a current ownership detector
original pinned SSH key, old guard and fresh board identity verified by root launcher
no live or outcome-unknown camera/USB/update/PM/other mutator; no reuse of any historical transaction
local full candidate and rollback hashes/96MiB bytes verified; packaging passed receipt bound to source f8e9a8ae
copy exact camera481 formal wrapper raw bytes, both pinned worker raw bytes and fresh guard into new root-owned 0700 directory; files 0600, no symlinks
runtime must still use R8 disk/loaded notes; no module unload/hot replacement or service start between quiesce and restart

quiesce.launch: one detached Popen, DEVNULL stdin, own log/PID/startticks; durable exclusive host and remote launch intent before dispatch
quiesce.required_terminal: state-private.json terminal=true exit_code=0, summary.json taint=0, exact transaction_id/boot_id/token, saved boot-id exact; original process absent/zombie confirmed before next mutator
quiesce.unknown: fetch same process/result only; do not clear directory or dispatch again

restart.inspect: read-only guards/quiesce/hardware idle checks; no /dev/mem open
restart.launch: one detached Popen with close_fds=True, start_new_session=True, stdin DEVNULL, stdout/stderr to unique verified tmpfs /run log; durable host request before dispatch, capture PID/startticks where possible
restart.claim: /run/<transaction_id>-reboot-phase-private.json exclusive x; transaction_id/boot_id/token/state=claimed_once/request_count=1, file and parent fsync before first freeze
restart.last_phase: filesystem_frozen_restart2_armed only proves intent; not syscall or bootloader success
restart.hardware: same old quiesce/retirement path, whole CSR known set 0/1/0x01010101, whole 0 readback, immediate single RESTART2 bootloader
restart.unknown: no second restart or automatic EUD rebind; same process/status and fresh host evidence only

host_boundary.required_context: same transaction_id/token/old_boot_id and exact guard hash, quiesce terminal/process evidence, one restart dispatch claim; never old R7 receipts
host_boundary.actions: inspect, flash-candidate, rollback-original and reboot require separate exclusive action claims; each uses fresh exact sole serial, msmnile product and boot partition 100663296 bytes
host_boundary.write_scope: candidate or exact a30 fallback to boot only; no Image/logdump/rootfs/modules/NV or other partition
host_boundary.unknown: any mutating child alive/unknown blocks subsequent mutation; no timeout replay or automatic rollback while prior write unknown
host_boundary.postboot: new boot UUID plus original key and fresh R8/camera481 health, Image/logdump and installed boot hash, panel/console/CSR/EUD evidence; create new adoption guard only after acceptance
